Seat: `repo:objectstack#5`
File surface: located by the dev's re-measure. The dotted-groupBy resolution for `aggregate` in `packages/objectql/src/**` (⛔ excluding `engine-insert.ts` and `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`, which open PR #35386 holds; stop and report if the fix needs them), the SQL driver's groupBy join builder under `packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/**`, the MCP `aggregate_records` door's refusal mapping if the 4xx is shaped there; a new test named for this card; root `.changeset/`. Stop on breach and report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — no path-derived mandate`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (a 500 becomes a typed 4xx refusal or a working grouping; measure on the diff)
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: platform — `aggregate_records` with a 4-hop dotted `groupBy` (`purchase_order.requisition.requester.department.name`) answered `500 DATABASE_ERROR`, so an MCP agent can't tell it should change approach; every MCP/REST caller grouping across deep lookups.
Thread-read: 6953040589
Premise: unmeasured on current main. The dev re-measures first; if a 4-hop groupBy no longer 500s on `origin/main`, the dev stops and reports with the reading (the card then closes as not reproducible).
Serial constraints cleared: no open data-1 claim holds the dotted-path or driver-sql groupBy files; #35386 holds `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` (excluded above).
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server` (`packages/objectql/**`, `packages/plugins/driver-sql/**`)
Pre-claim deps: none. Related closed cards #33664, #29304, #21232 (different shapes; dev reads them).
Prior rulings read: check-prior-rulings 146 ADR candidates, none on a groupBy hop limit (top: ADR-0029 D9.7, ADR-0041 §4, ADR-0103 D3, ADR-0130 D8); thread: 1 (triage p2)
